english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a person or family with a lot of money and possessions.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is financially wealthy.
Use this specifically when prosperous means personally wealthy or well-off, rather than generally successful.

examples.english: That family is rich; they live in a big house and drive nice cars.
examples.traditional: 佢哋一家人好有錢，住大屋又揸靚車。

examples.english: Their family is wealthy and lives in a big house on the Peak.
examples.traditional: 佢屋企好有錢，住喺半山嗰間大屋。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 uk1 kei2 hou2 jau5 cin2 zyu6 hai2 bun3 saan1 go2 gaan1 daai6 uk1

examples.english: That whole family is very prosperous.
